        Release Notes and Installation & Licensing User Assistance
 
   The Release Notes and the installation user assistance are accessible
   from the SIMULIA Established Products documentation.
   They are also accessible at http://help.3ds.com.
   Select the SIMULIA Version for this release, then select
   the SIMULIA Established Products link and click on the section
   on the left. The Release Notes can be found under Abaqus > Release Notes.
   Abaqus installation and licensing information is available
   under Installation, Licensing & Configuration.
 
   The list of supported platforms and other system requirements is given
   in the Dassault Systemes Program Directory. The Program Directory is
   additional documentation, similar to release notes, available at
   http://media.3ds.com/support/progdir. Choose SIMULIA as the
   product line and the appropriate level, then choose
   Prerequisites in the left-hand pane. A support contract and private
   login account are required for access.
